verdict: ROAS strong at 3.54, but purchases are lumpy — holding before scaling.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $3.54 for every $1.00 spent — a meaningful jump driven largely by the Muslim Subscription Box campaign, which accounted for 57% of spend and delivered 22 purchases totalling $5,311.58 in revenue. That said, most days logged zero purchases, and the last three days of the period were very quiet, so this is event-driven performance rather than a steady run rate. We're holding spend where it is rather than scaling until purchase activity shows more consistency. The live-cooking content shoot, which is the planned fix for ad frequency fatigue in retargeting, is being rescheduled and remains a priority for the weeks ahead.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend over the last 28 days — $3.54 back for every $1.00 spent
purchases driven by Meta ads this period, generating $5,311.58 in revenue
total ad spend this period, averaging $55.61 per day

watch_item.issue: Purchase volume is concentrated in single-day spikes rather than spread evenly — the underlying ad creative is showing frequency fatigue in retargeting audiences.
watch_item.fix: A live-cooking content shoot is being scheduled now to bring in fresh footage and relieve that fatigue before we consider increasing spend.
